consent.title: Follow the streets?
consent.body: To draw your route along streets, your route stops are sent to the OpenStreetMap route service:
consent.privacy: They’re rounded to about 10 m and sent without your account details. Like any website, that service also sees your phone’s IP address and may keep both in its logs. Nothing is sent unless you agree. You can change this in Info.
consent.straightHint: Straight lines: nothing is sent, and the route is still measured.
